description: Use when someone wants to check where their organisation stands with data protection. The questions of EasyLPD's self-assessment that apply to an organisation's profile, each with its id, area, why it matters, its weight and the legal references. Ask them in the conversation, a few at a time, answer each with yes, partial, no, unknown (the person does not know: it counts as not in place until checked) or na, then call score_assessment.

ai.description: Uses AI systems in its work (AI assistants, chatbots, automated screening or scoring).

ch.description: Established in Switzerland, or processing data of people in Switzerland.

euEstablishment.description: Has an establishment (branch, subsidiary, office) in the EU/EEA.

euMonitoring.description: Monitors the behaviour of people in the EU/EEA (online tracking, profiling).

euOffer.description: Offers goods or services to people in the EU/EEA.

freeOnly.description: Only the questions of the free assessment (true) or all (false).

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.

name: assessment_questions
title: Data protection self-assessment questions
